name: University of Tennessee
tuition_note: In-state tuition & fees $13,876/yr from admissions.utk.edu/undergraduate-tuition-aid (published 2025-26 cost of attendance; page disclaimer references 2024-25 base). Housing is room only from studentlife.utk.edu/housing/housing-options/2026_2027-rates (proposed 2026-27, per person per semester): used representative standard community-style double (Geier/Robinson/Magnolia) at $4,500/semester x2 = $9,000/yr. Rates range ~$7,860 (Hess double) to ~$12,050 (single) per year. Admissions page only lists combined Housing & Food of $14,738; room-only figure taken from housing office rates page.
